cost_semantics: Cell HTTP is attribution only: shared N04/N05 transport and N05/N12 adapters must be deduplicated using their original shared receipt before summing. Market dimensions do not multiply source quotas.
market_semantics: Market type uses validated declared upstream roles and explicit normalized same-run trade receipts. Catalog/prose/score do not establish useful per-market facts. N04 is on-chain; N15 uses aggregate sector quotes; N11 is futures-only.
